title: BigRedHeadofAir's Magical World
description: Various custom items/blocks to remove grind from survival! Grindstones are not removed.
body:
Hi!
This datapack will make survival less grindy, so that you can finally play Minecraft and not Cave Game. This datapack will be updated to newer versions, but there will be lag as I do not want to develop a datapack without mods (mojang please make the vanilla game more bearable at least fix antialiasing oh right there is none)

### This datapack does not require a resource pack!

# Installation

1. download the .zip file from Modrinth
2. create a new world in Minecraft
3. select "more" on the top menu
4. press the "datapacks" button
5. press the "open pack folder" button on the bottom
6. find the .zip file you downloaded and drag it into the folder that was opened by the game
7. go back to the game and press "done" on the bottom
8. finish creating the world and enjoy!
9. if you encounter any issues, try typing the /reload command in-game.
10. if you still need help, look for a youtube tutorial on installing datapacks (do note the date though as the minecraft menu has changed a bit over the years)

# Latest Features

- Hydraulic Piston
- Jetpack

Read the descriptions of my YouTube videos [(Playlist Link)]([https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLB_iG8ncElGsZGo2LJ9DfjbHNqTAG1X2Q]) for obtaining and using these items. When the list is big enough I will make a tutorial video for the datapack including all the features.
